instrument: Work Health and Safety Regulations (model provisions on hazardous chemicals, as adopted in the applicable jurisdiction)
provision: Storage of hazardous chemicals above manifest quantities — manifest, placarding, emergency planning and segregation duties
jurisdiction: Australia. The model provisions are adopted with variation; non-harmonised jurisdictions impose equivalent duties under separate dangerous goods legislation. Confirm the adopting instrument before relying on this entry.
bearer: person conducting a business or undertaking with management or control of the workplace
reentry_triggers: Any change in the class, quantity or packaging of goods held
Arrival of a consignment that has not been assessed against the segregation plan
Change of use in an adjacent tenancy, occupancy or neighbouring site
Alteration to the building fabric, bunding, ventilation or fire systems
Expiry or variation of a licence, permit or approval relied on
Following any incident, near-miss or emergency service attendance

applicability.condition: Applies where hazardous chemicals are held at or above the quantity thresholds set by the applicable schedule. Scope can be entered by ordinary trading — a larger order, slower turnover, a temporary consolidation — with no decision taken and nobody aware.
applicability.threshold_basis: Quantity thresholds are defined in the schedules to the adopting jurisdiction's regulations. Read the figures from the instrument in force; they vary by jurisdiction and by chemical class, and a threshold recalled from memory is worse in a register than an honest pointer.
applicability.monitoring_control: Stock-holding report reconciled against the threshold schedule at each inventory cycle, with a standing alert at a margin below the threshold rather than at it

summary: Where hazardous chemicals are stored at or above the applicable quantity thresholds, the duty holder must maintain a current manifest of what is held and where, display the required placarding at the site and at storage locations, keep safety data sheets current and accessible, store incompatible classes with the required separation, and maintain an emergency plan prepared in consultation with the emergency services. The duties attach to the state of the site rather than to any particular action, and continue for as long as the goods are held.

gate_criteria.criterion: Is the licence, permit or approval relied on for the goods held current at today's date?

validity.monitored_by: Permit register with expiry alerting at 90, 30 and 7 days

gate_criteria.criterion: Does the approved segregation plan cover the classes actually on site, as distinct from the classes the plan was written for?
Is the manifest current as at the last movement of goods, rather than as at the last audit?
Has the emergency plan been provided to the emergency services and reviewed since the last material change to holdings or site layout?
Are the personnel on shift trained for the classes currently held, and is that training current?

validity.monitored_by: Training matrix with currency flags by class

controls.control: Bunding, ventilation, ignition-source control and fire detection appropriate to the classes held
Placarding at site entry and at storage locations, positioned to be legible to an approaching emergency response
Manifest updated at each movement of goods, held at the designated location
Segregation enforced by physical layout rather than by labelling alone
Safety data sheets obtained at receipt and refreshed on the supplier's revision cycle
Lease or occupancy covenant requiring notice of any change of use in adjacent tenancies
Carrier and supplier terms requiring advance notification of class or packaging changes

evidence_types.record: Manifest versions with the time of each movement
evidence_types.retention: per records schedule; retain through the period any goods were held

evidence_types.record: Placarding photographs at installation and after each layout change
Segregation plan, versioned, with the approval that adopted it
evidence_types.retention: life of the storage arrangement plus limitation period

evidence_types.record: Inspection and test records for bunding, ventilation and fire systems
Training completions by person and by class, with currency dates
evidence_types.retention: duration of employment plus limitation period

evidence_types.record: Emergency plan issue and acknowledgement by the emergency services
Stock-holding reconciliation against the threshold schedule

assurance_activities: Independent physical inspection against the segregation plan, comparing goods present to goods planned for
Reconciliation of the manifest to physical stock on an unannounced basis
Confirmation that the emergency plan held by responders matches the plan on site
Review of threshold monitoring for whether scope was entered between cycles rather than at one

source: The adopting jurisdiction's work health and safety regulations and any separate dangerous goods legislation; regulator guidance material for the applicable class.
notes: Deliberately records no numeric thresholds. Quantities vary by jurisdiction and class, and a figure carried in a register without a citation is the kind of confident error that survives review. The threshold_basis field points to where the figures are read; the monitoring control watches the crossing. Note also that currently_in_scope is 'unknown' — an honest state for a demonstration entry, and one the coverage checker will report rather than silently pass.
